class-8/science/term-1.edition_note: These are HISTORICAL Tamil Nadu SCERT Class 8 Science Term I textbooks, first edition 2019, with nine corresponding chapter titles (Measurement, Forces and Pressure, Light, Matter, Changes Around Us, Micro Organisms, Plant Kingdom, Organisation of Life, Introduction to the Information Age). The source directory's explicitly 2019 term-wise Tamil Science link opens a Google Drive document titled '8th_Std_Term_I_Science_TM.pdf'; its identity, medium and 2019 edition are supported by the directory and a separately readable original Tamil text mirror with the same nine chapter titles. The English first-edition 2019 volume's table of contents is readable in its original SCERT PDF (the full PDF screenshot tool cannot display the file because of its size). IMPORTANT: The ClearExams question bank metadata says 2025; these older reference texts are NOT independently certified as the 2025 or currently prescribed 2026–27 edition. No Tamil question/explanation matches or printed-page alignments were independently certified; the large Google Drive Tamil file could not be downloaded and page-verified here. Treat these as historical same-language topic references only.
